props.heading: Born from the soil, built for the future
props.subheading: We are a team of agronomists, engineers and nature lovers on a mission to make every farm in India a self-sustaining ecosystem.

props.html:
Our vision

A self-sustaining farm on every piece of land: the land feeds the farmer, the farmer nurtures the land, and together they create abundance that lasts generations.

Our mission

To combine satellite technology, permaculture science and hands-on execution to turn any piece of land into a thriving, productive, self-sustaining farm. We handle everything from design to management.

Our values

  • Nature first: Every decision starts with what is best for the ecosystem. Zero chemicals, always.
  • Radical transparency: Every visit documented, every rupee accounted for, every decision explained.
  • Science over guesswork: Satellite data, contour maps and soil analysis: we design with data.
  • Complete ownership: We execute, manage and take full responsibility for your farm.
  • Community impact: Local employment, skills for rural youth and degraded land restored.
  • Long-term thinking: We design for decades: every farm is a 30-year asset.

props.heading: Farm design
props.subheading: Satellite imagery, NDVI analysis and contour maps turn into a complete layout: every swale, bund, tree row and planting zone placed along the natural contour.

props.html:
• NDVI vegetation analysis: Colour-coded maps of plant health, bare spots and biological activity.
  • Elevation and slope mapping: Topographic data down to 30 cm changes in elevation.
  • Keyline design: Swales and bunds on the keylines to hold the most moisture.
  • Zonal planting plan: Fruit, timber, spice and forest zones placed by sun, wind and water access.

props.heading: Earthwork and land preparation
props.subheading: Swales to harvest rainwater, basins for moisture, ponds for the microclimate and terraces for slopes. Every cubic foot of earth moved has an ecological purpose.

props.html:
• Bio-swales and basins: Structures that slow, sink and spread water across the contour lines.
  • Ponds: Water storage that also cools the microclimate.
  • Boundary and wind breaks: Tabebuia, Pongamia, bamboo and mahogany as natural boundaries.

props.heading: Planting
props.subheading: Multi-layer planting from our own nursery: boundary trees, green manure, quick-yield crops, fruit trees and timber, each in the right zone.

props.html:
• Boundary plantation: Tabebuia, Pongamia, wild badam, bamboo and mahogany for wind breaks and privacy.
  • Green manure: Sesbania, Gliricidia, Moringa, Vetiver and Lemongrass for organic matter.
  • Short-term yield: Lemon, banana, papaya, pineapple and mulberry for early returns.
  • Fruiting plants: Jackfruit, avocado, litchi, orange and musambi.
  • Timber trees: Mahogany, sandalwood, red sandal and rosewood as a long-term asset.

props.heading: Site assessment
props.subheading: Our agronomists walk your land and study soil texture, water sources, slope and microclimate. Everything else is built on this.

props.html:
• Soil analysis: Samples from several points for pH, organic matter, nutrients and microbial activity.
  • Water source mapping: Borewells, springs, seasonal streams and the rainfall pattern.
  • Microclimate study: Sun exposure, wind, frost pockets and shade across the seasons.

props.heading: Water management
props.subheading: Rainwater is slowed, sunk and spread across the land, so the farm handles both drought and heavy rain by design.

props.html:
• Bio-swales: Rainwater harvesting structures along the contour lines.
  • Basins: Hold moisture at the root zone of each plant.
  • Drip irrigation: Water delivered by zone, with nothing wasted.
  • Fertigation setup: Drum, venturi and shade structure for mixing nutrients into the drip.

Why choose us

  • Intelligent farm design: Satellite mapping, contour analysis and a layout made for your land: its slope, soil and water flow.
  • 200+ native varieties: Saplings from our own nursery. No middlemen; every sapling is traceable and acclimatised.
  • Full-time farm team: Trained agronomists and field staff, not freelancers. Every visit is documented.
  • Radical transparency: Photo reports, GPS-tagged visits and monthly activity logs, so you always know what is happening on your farm.
  • 30-year vision: Every tree placement plans for its 30-year canopy, shade and yield cycle.

testimonials.author: Rajesh M
testimonials.body: A very well maintained nursery with knowledgeable staff. I got fruit plants from here and they're all growing really well in our farm. Planning to visit again. Keep up the good work!

testimonials.author: Sornah Pandian
testimonials.body: This beautiful farm has a whole range of saplings, all naturally grown with a lustrous, healthy look. I'd recommend anyone to visit, enjoy the green view, and let them give you a tour with detailed explanations about each plant.

testimonials.author: Yash Shah
testimonials.body: Before visiting Hasiru Agro, I thought I knew farming. There is so much to learn. I found new and effective techniques that yield better results. Amazing quality saplings and really sweet people!
